title: Section 6: WhoIs classify fail-closed design is correct and should be defended
description: auth.rs:classify() maps store errors to WhoIsFailed (500-class) not Unauthorized (401). This is the correct fail-closed design: a DB failure during authorization MUST not accidentally grant access. A future contributor might suggest 'just return 401 on store error to avoid 500s' — this would be wrong. The 500 is intentional: it forces investigation of why the store is broken rather than silently denying. The classify_store_error_fails_closed test locks this behavior in.
